name: Sahil Rathod
intro: I connect thoughtful interfaces with the systems that make them work.
bio: I’m a full stack developer with a builder’s instinct. I like taking an idea apart, understanding what it needs, and turning it into something people can actually use.

My personal projects move between web interfaces, creator workflows, and experiments with local AI. The interesting part is where they meet: a clear experience on the surface, and deliberate engineering underneath.
